REST creates a ticket with owner identity
B rejects its Cognito token at the original A GraphQL API
REST owner read/update and cross-owner denial
REST custom Lambda authorizer: Agents allowed, owner denied
AppSync default resolver reads REST writes and enforces ownership
AppSync generated create/update resolvers write shared DynamoDB
REST and GraphQL records exist in B physical DynamoDB table
Personal REST/GraphQL lists separate two Agents; Agent queue includes only Agents tickets
AppSync custom Lambda summary/close and cross-owner denial
WebSocket rejects invalid Cognito JWT at $connect
REST and GraphQL comments persist with verified authors and ticket authorization
WebSocket pushes REST ticket creation and status updates to owner and Agents
WebSocket pushes generated GraphQL creates/updates and custom Lambda status changes
WebSocket push does not expose another owner tickets or comment bodies
WebSocket owner response, other-owner denial and Agents access
AppSync generated delete resolver removes ticket
REST cross-owner delete denied; owner delete succeeds
